options.name: attributes
options.description: List of attribute names separated by ',' which needs to be extracted. Note that preceding and trailing spaces will be removed. Attribute name can be 127 bytes and total length of this string should not cross 1023 bytes. These attributes have multi-value support separated by ',' and stored as key-value pair in AAA session

options.name: audience
options.description: Audience for which token sent by Authorization server is applicable. This is typically entity name or url that represents the recipient

options.name: authentication
options.description: If authentication is disabled, password is not sent in the request.

options.name: authorizationendpoint
options.description: Authorization endpoint/url to which unauthenticated user will be redirected. Citrix ADC redirects user to this endpoint by adding query parameters including clientid. If this parameter not specified then as default value we take Token Endpoint/URL value. Please note that Authorization Endpoint or Token Endpoint is mandatory for oauthAction

options.name: certendpoint
options.description: URL of the endpoint that contains JWKs (Json Web Key) for JWT (Json Web Token) verification.

options.name: certfilepath
options.description: Path to the file that contains JWKs (Json Web Key) for JWT (Json Web Token) verification.

options.name: clientid
options.description: Unique identity of the client/user who is getting authenticated. Authorization server infers client configuration using this ID

options.name: clientsecret
options.description: Secret string established by user and authorization server

options.name: defaultauthenticationgroup
options.description: This is the default group that is chosen when the authentication succeeds in addition to extracted groups.

options.name: granttype
options.description: Grant type support. value can be code or password

options.name: graphendpoint
options.description: URL of the Graph API service to learn Enterprise Mobility Services (EMS) endpoints.

options.name: idtokendecryptendpoint
options.description: URL to which obtained idtoken will be posted to get a decrypted user identity. Encrypted idtoken will be obtained by posting OAuth token to token endpoint. In order to decrypt idtoken, Citrix ADC posts request to the URL configured

options.name: introspecturl
options.description: URL to which access token would be posted for validation

options.name: intunedeviceidexpression
options.description: The expression that will be evaluated to obtain IntuneDeviceId for compliance check against IntuneNAC device compliance endpoint. The expression is applicable when the OAuthType is INTUNE. The maximum length allowed to be used as IntuneDeviceId for the device compliance check from the computed response after the expression evaluation is 41. Examples: add authentication oauthAction <actionName> -intuneDeviceIdExpression 'AAA.LOGIN.INTUNEURI.AFTER_STR("IntuneDeviceId://")'

options.name: issuer
options.description: Identity of the server whose tokens are to be accepted.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: metadataurl
options.description: Well-known configuration endpoint of the Authorization Server. Citrix ADC fetches server details from this endpoint.

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the OAuth Authentication action. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore character (_), and must contain only letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-), period (.) pound (#), space ( ), at (@), equals (=), colon (:), and underscore characters. Cannot be changed after the profile is created.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my authentication ac

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: oauthmiscflags
options.description: Option to set/unset miscellaneous feature flags. Available values function as follows: * C(Base64Encode_Authorization_With_Padding) - On setting this value, for endpoints (token and introspect), basic authorization header will be base64 encoded with padding. * C(EnableJWTRequest) - By enabling this field, Authorisation request to IDP will have jwt signed 'request' parameter

options.name: oauthtype
options.description: Type of the OAuth implementation. Default value is generic implementation that is applicable for most deployments.

options.name: pkce
options.description: Option to enable/disable PKCE flow during authentication.

options.name: refreshinterval
options.description: Interval at which services are monitored for necessary configuration.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: requestattribute
options.description: Name-Value pairs of attributes to be inserted in request parameter. Configuration format is name=value_expr@@@name2=value2_expr@@@. '@@@' is used as delimiter between Name-Value pairs. name is a literal string whose value is 127 characters and does not contain '=' character. Value is advanced policy expression terminated by @@@ delimiter. Last value need not contain the delimiter.

options.name: resourceuri
options.description: Resource URL for Oauth configuration.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: skewtime
options.description: This option specifies the allowed clock skew in number of minutes that Citrix ADC allows on an incoming token. For example, if skewTime is 10, then token would be valid from (current time - 10) min to (current time + 10) min, ie 20min in all.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tenantid
options.description: TenantID of the application. This is usually specific to providers such as Microsoft and usually refers to the deployment identifier.

options.name: tokenendpoint
options.description: URL to which OAuth token will be posted to verify its authenticity. User obtains this token from Authorization server upon successful authentication. Citrix ADC will validate presented token by posting it to the URL configured

options.name: tokenendpointauthmethod
options.description: Option to select the variant of token authentication method. This method is used while exchanging code with IdP.

options.name: userinfourl
options.description: URL to which OAuth access token will be posted to obtain user information.

options.name: usernamefield
options.description: Attribute in the token from which username should be extracted.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
